blocks.title: <ico-recycle></ico-recycle> REPASO EXPRESS · lección anterior
blocks.intro: Antes de empezar, recupera lo de la clase pasada. Une cada palabra con su significado — sin mirar atrás.

blocks.title: <ico-book></ico-book> WILL vs GOING TO vs -ING
blocks.intro: El inglés tiene tres futuros y cada uno dice algo distinto: will (decisión del momento, promesa, predicción), going to (plan o evidencia) y present continuous (cita ya agendada). Cinco pasos. Toca el altavoz de cada línea y repite en voz alta.

vocab.en: by the end of the month

vocab.sp: estar en la hoja de ruta

blocks.note: Cómo funciona: tarjetas , memoria , comparar , escucha , completar y unir . CHECK donde lo veas.

parts.html: 1 · WILL — decides en el momento, o prometes

items.en: I'll send it tonight. I promise.
items.sp: Te lo envío esta noche. Lo prometo.

items.en: I'll have it done by the fifteenth.
items.sp: Lo tendré listo para el quince.

parts.body: En español esto va en presente («Yo atiendo», «Te lo envío»). En inglés necesita will: I get it! → I'll get it!

parts.html: 2 · WILL PARA PREDECIR — lo que crees que va a pasar

items.en: I think sales will double next year.
items.sp: Creo que las ventas se van a duplicar el año que viene.

items.en: The page will load in under two seconds.
items.sp: La página va a cargar en menos de dos segundos.

items.en: It won't be ready this year.
items.sp: No va a estar lista este año. — won't = will not.

parts.html: 3 · GOING TO — plan ya decidido, o evidencia a la vista

items.en: I'm going to improve the checkout speed.
items.sp: Voy a mejorar la velocidad del checkout. — ya lo tenías decidido.

items.en: Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.
items.sp: Mira esas nubes: va a llover. — lo ves venir.

parts.html: 4 · PRESENT CONTINUOUS — ya está en el calendario

items.en: I'm meeting the designers on Monday.
items.sp: Me reúno con los diseñadores el lunes.

items.en: We're launching the app in October.
He's visiting our office next Friday.
items.sp: Visita nuestra oficina el próximo viernes.

parts.body: Si tiene día y hora y ya está acordado, usa -ing. Con will suena a que lo decides ahora: I will meet the designers on Monday at nine. → I'm meeting the designers on Monday at nine.

parts.html: 5 · BY + FECHA LÍMITE — para cuándo estará listo

items.sp: para el viernes — ese día como máximo.

items.en: by the end of the month

parts.body: By no es until. By = fecha límite; until = «hasta», algo que dura todo ese tiempo: I'll finish it until Friday. → I'll finish it by Friday. · I'll work until six.

blocks.title: <ico-star></ico-star> THE ROADMAP
blocks.intro: Fin de trimestre. Priya reúne al equipo para planear el que viene: fase dos, metas, fechas. Y al final de la reunión, una noticia grande: David tiene planes de expansión… y alguien va a tener que presentar the big pitch.

blocks.title: MEMORY · forma y uso
blocks.intro: Encuentra cada forma de futuro con su uso. Toca dos cartas.

blocks.title: WILL vs GOING TO vs PRESENT CONTINUOUS
blocks.intro: Tres futuros, tres mensajes distintos: una decisión del momento, una intención con evidencia, y una cita ya agendada.

pair.b: I'm sending the report at five.

items.q: ¿Cuál es una decisión que tomas justo en ese momento (te ofreces)?
¿Cuál es una cita ya agendada, con hora?
Miras las nubes negras: hay evidencia de que va a llover. ¿Qué dices?
Suena el teléfono y te ofreces a contestarlo. ¿Qué dices?

blocks.title: AUDIO 1 · THE PLANNING CALL
blocks.desc: Priya, Sofia y Marcos planean el próximo trimestre. Fechas, promesas y predicciones — los tres futuros en acción.

questions.q: When are they launching the mobile app?
What is Marcos going to improve first?
What is Sofia doing on Monday?

speaking.prompt: Describe the team's roadmap in 3 sentences. Use going to, present continuous, and by + time.
speaking.starter: They're launching the app in October. Marcos is going to (his task), and by the end of the month, (what will be ready).

transcript.html: Okay team, last meeting of the quarter. Let's look ahead — what's the roadmap?
Phase two. We're launching the mobile app in October. It's all arranged — I'm meeting the designers on Monday to start.
First, I'm going to improve the checkout speed — that's my main goal. By the end of the month, the page will load in under two seconds.
Under two seconds? Will you really finish by then?
Don't worry — I'll have it done by the fifteenth. I promise.
Then I'm happy. And here's my forecast: with the app and a faster checkout, I think GreenMarket's sales will double next year.
Double? I'll hold you to that prediction, Priya!
Ha! Let's see. Right — great quarter, everyone. And Marcos… check your messages after this. I have news.

blocks.title: WILL, GOING TO o -ING
blocks.intro: Elige el futuro correcto según la situación.

items.q: Look at those clouds — it ___ rain.
I promise I ___ send the report tonight.
We ___ launching phase two in October.
She ___ to study English in Canada next year.
I'll have the report ready ___ Friday.
The phone's ringing! — Don't worry, I ___ get it.
I ___ the designers at ten — it's in my calendar.
I'll work on it ___ six, then I'm going home.
I think sales ___ double next year.

blocks.title: UNE LAS EXPRESIONES DE TIEMPO

blocks.title: AUDIO 2 · THE MESSAGE <ico-crown></ico-crown>
blocks.desc: El mensaje que Priya le dejó a Marcos después de la reunión. Una noticia grande… y un desafío más grande.

questions.q: What is David going to do?
options: Open a new office in Mexico

questions.q: What is Marcos doing next Friday?
Why does Priya want Marcos to present?
options: David asked for him by name
He has grown a lot this quarter
She is going to be on holiday

questions.q: When is David visiting the office?

speaking.prompt: You are Marcos. Answer Priya's message: accept the challenge and say TWO things you're going to prepare.
speaking.starter: Hi Priya, thanks for trusting me! I'll do it. First, I'm going to prepare (first thing), and by Thursday I'll (second thing).

transcript.html: Marcos, it's Priya. Here's the news. David called me this morning — GreenMarket is going to expand. Three new countries next year. Spain, Portugal… and Mexico. It's huge. He's visiting our office next Friday, and he wants to see the full plan. And here's the thing: I'm not going to present it. You are. You've grown so much this quarter — you run meetings, you negotiate, you push back with data. You're ready. So, next Friday, the big pitch. Prepare well, get some rest before it… and don't worry. I know you'll be brilliant. Talk soon.

blocks.title: <ico-pen></ico-pen> MY ROADMAP
blocks.intro: Escribe TU roadmap personal para los próximos 3 meses (inglés, trabajo, vida — 6–8 frases):
checklist: 1 cita ya fijada con present continuous + fecha (I'm …ing on…)
2 fechas límite con by (by August, by the end of…)
blocks.placeholder: Next quarter is going to be big for me. First, I'm going to…
blocks.example: Next quarter is going to be big for me. I'm going to plan and I'm going to plan. I'm verbo-ing persona / lugar on fecha. I'll promesa by fecha límite. By the end of mes, I'll logro. I think algo will predicción.
blocks.hw: Escribe tu roadmap y después grábate presentándolo sin leer, como si fuera tu pitch. Envíame ambos por WhatsApp. ¡Y prepárate: el BOSS te espera!

rubric.d: Escribiste el número de frases que pide la consigna y cubriste todos los puntos.
Usaste will / going to / present continuous + by + fecha al menos 3 veces, y bien.
Un lector lo entiende sin releer: ideas unidas con conectores, sin traducir literal del español.
